mapper.sql: SELECT sp.*, s.name as supply_point_name FROM spare_part sp LEFT JOIN supply_point s ON sp.supply_point_id = s.id
mapper.select: WHERE sp.stock_quantity <= sp.warning_threshold ORDER BY sp.stock_quantity ASC LIMIT 10
WHERE sp.supply_point_id = #{supplyPointId} ORDER BY sp.create_time DESC
SELECT category AS name, SUM(stock_quantity) AS "value" FROM spare_part GROUP BY category ORDER BY "value" DESC
SELECT category AS name, SUM(stock_quantity * unit_price) AS "value", COUNT(*) AS itemCount, 'category' AS dimension FROM spare_part GROUP BY category ORDER BY "value" DESC

SELECT s.name AS name, SUM(sp.stock_quantity * sp.unit_price) AS "value", COUNT(*) AS itemCount, 'supplyPoint' AS dimension FROM spare_part sp LEFT JOIN supply_point s ON sp.supply_point_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY "value" DESC

SELECT sp.id AS partId, sp.part_code AS partCode, sp.part_name AS partName, sp.category AS category, sp.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, sp.unit_price AS unitPrice, (sp.stock_quantity * sp.unit_price) AS totalValue, s.name AS supplyPointName FROM spare_part sp LEFT JOIN supply_point s ON sp.supply_point_id = s.id ORDER BY (sp.stock_quantity * sp.unit_price) DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spare_part WHERE stock_quantity <= warning_threshold

SELECT s.name AS supplyPointName, COUNT(sp.id) AS totalItems, COALESCE(SUM(sp.stock_quantity * sp.unit_price), 0) AS totalValue, SUM(CASE WHEN sp.stock_quantity <= sp.warning_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowStockItems, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN sp.stock_quantity <= sp.warning_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(sp.id), 0), 0 ) AS lowStockRatio, COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM stock_record sr WHERE sr.part_id = sp.id AND sr.type = 'out' AND sr.operate_time >= #{startDate} AND sr.operate_time < #{endDate}) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sp.stock_quantity, 0), 0 ) AS avgTurnoverRate, COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM stock_record sr WHERE sr.part_id = sp.id AND sr.type = 'in' AND sr.operate_time >= #{startDate} AND sr.operate_time < #{endDate}), 0 ) AS stockInQuantity, COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM stock_record sr WHERE sr.part_id = sp.id AND sr.type = 'out' AND sr.operate_time >= #{startDate} AND sr.operate_time < #{endDate}), 0 ) AS stockOutQuantity FROM spare_part sp LEFT JOIN supply_point s ON sp.supply_point_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name, sp.id ORDER BY totalValue DESC
